journey.name: Delete Recipe
journey.description: Test deleting a recipe from the detail page: navigate to a recipe, tap delete, confirm deletion, verify navigation back to Home

actions.action: Tap the "Home" tab at the bottom of the screen
Tap the last recipe card in the list
Verify the Recipe Detail page appears with the recipe name
Verify a confirmation dialog or alert appears
Confirm the deletion by tapping the confirm or OK button
Verify the app navigates back to the Home screen
